statement: Warren 2026-10-07 chose option (c): stay on the Cloudflare quick tunnel. No domain, no named tunnel. Accepted consequences: the public address changes whenever cloudflared restarts, and company managed Chrome cannot open *.trycloudflare.com (phones on mobile data and unmanaged browsers can). N-0073 must surface the current address after each restart and avoid needless tunnel restarts. N-0074 is deferred.
